content.title: Rory McIlroy earnings: Breaking down how much money career Grand Slam winner has made, net worth | Sporting News
content.text: Rory McIlroy burst onto the golf scene at a young age, winning the U.S. Open at just 21 years old and adding wins at the PGA Championship and Open Championship soon after. While he quickly became one of the most recognizable players in the sport, McIlroy carried the burden of trying to win the Masters and a career Grand Slam — which he finally accomplished with his triumph at Augusta National in 2025. With his Masters victory, McIlroy has 29 PGA Tour career titles, meaning he's earned himself a hefty payout while competing on the Tour. The popularity that came with his early-career success also brought along numerous endorsement deals. 📲 Follow The Sporting News on WhatsAppHere's what you need to know about McIlroy's career earnings following his long-awaited Masters win.Rory McIlroy career earningsMcIlroy has earned $185.6 million in his career, according to Spotrac. He and Tiger Woods are the only golfers in the history of the PGA Tour to surpass $100 million in career earnings.McIlroy has made more than $76 million from winning official tournaments. His largest payout from a tournament was $4.5 million from the 2025 Players' Championship. The 2025 Masters victory brought home $4.2 million.McIlroy has earned more than $10 million playing in major championships, with the Masters being his biggest prize.Another $30.5 million has come through the Player Impact Program, which is set up to reward players who, in the PGA Tour's words, “generate the most positive interest in the PGA Tour." He also has received $8.9 million in bonuses for Tour Top 10 finishes.Rory McIlroy net worthAccording to Celebrity Net Worth, McIlroy has an estimated net worth of $200 million.On top of his PGA Tour winnings, McIlroy's popularity has earned him numerous endorsement deals over the years. Among other deals, he has an equipment contract with Taylor Made, reportedly worth more than $100 million.McIlroy's incredible success at a young age, including four major championships by the age of 25, made him one of the faces of golf. His 2025 Masters win gave him the career grand slam, a feat that only five other players in the history of the game have accomplished.
